channel.title: Blocktape
channel.description: Blocktape reports crypto news: exchange and market moves, protocol upgrades, token launches, security incidents, regulation and enforcement across chains.

item.title: Coinbase to power Marqeta stablecoin card programs
item.description: Marqeta says Coinbase will provide custody, fiat conversion and Base settlement for stablecoin-funded cards, while Marqeta handles issuing and processing.

item.title: How to replace an unsupported token in your wallet
item.description: If a wallet says a token is unsupported, check the network and contract first; import it for display, or follow the issuer’s migration process to replace it.

item.title: DOGE needs a bridge to trade in smart contracts
item.description: DOGE can enter smart-contract trading as a token on a compatible network; the bridge, liquidity and exit route determine what you can do and what risks you take.

item.title: Marqeta and Coinbase team up on stablecoin-backed cards
item.description: Coinbase will handle custody and fiat conversion for stablecoin-backed cards issued through Marqeta, with Base providing settlement for enterprise customers.

item.title: What to Do When a Crypto Bridge Quote Expires
item.description: An expired bridge quote is a stale offer, not proof that funds moved: check wallet activity, then reprice the same transfer before approving anything.

item.title: Why a mempool backlog delays your crypto transaction
item.description: A mempool backlog keeps a transaction out of a block until capacity and its fee make it competitive, while a wallet’s status may take time to update.

item.title: How to move inherited crypto into a family wallet
item.description: Inherited crypto reaches a family wallet only after heirs establish authority, identify the holdings, check network compatibility and test a transfer first.

item.title: How to Choose a Redemption Path for Wrapped Crypto
item.description: Wrapped assets can return through a bridge, an issuer or a market sale; the right route depends on redemption rights, fees, liquidity and withdrawal delays.

item.title: Adding a Bridged Token Shows Its Destination-Chain Balance
item.description: Adding a bridged token makes its destination-chain balance visible, but does not move funds or prove redemption; check the network and contract before importing.

item.title: Cross-Chain Vesting Keeps Token Unlocks on Schedule
item.description: Cross-chain vesting applies a token release schedule across blockchains, using contracts and messages to control when beneficiaries can claim their allocations.

item.title: How to Fund a Solana Trading Wallet From Ethereum
item.description: Bridge an Ethereum asset into a Solana wallet by checking the route, the token mint and the SOL needed for fees; the transfer may deliver a wrapped token.

item.title: International crypto payouts hinge on the route to cash
item.description: International crypto payouts depend on matching the asset, blockchain and recipient’s cash-out route; compare total fees and check the destination before sending.

item.title: Why Smart Contract Pauses Stop Pending Token Transfers
item.description: A pause can block a transfer that was already sent but not yet confirmed, because the contract checks its current state when the transaction executes.

item.title: How to Use Bitcoin as Collateral Through a Relay Bridge
item.description: A relay bridge can make Bitcoin usable as collateral on another chain, but users must check custody, asset matching, confirmations and liquidation rules first.

item.title: How to Replace a Stalled Token Approval
item.description: A stalled token approval is a pending transaction. Replace it with the same nonce and a higher fee, then check the receipt and token allowance on-chain.

item.title: Four checks when a Mantle bridge deposit stalls
item.description: A stalled Mantle deposit is usually diagnosed by checking the Ethereum transaction, token approval, destination address and Mantle balance before submitting again.

item.title: Bitcoin UTXO Fees and Bridge Swap Costs in Wallets
item.description: A Bitcoin UTXO spend pays for transaction data; a bridge swap adds chain fees, liquidity costs and execution steps, so compare the final amount received.

item.title: Ledger tightens reseller rules after $93 million wallet theft
item.description: Ledger is tightening reseller rules and reviewing tamper protections after a reported $93 million theft linked to implanted components in devices sold in Southeast Asia.

item.title: Relay Bridge Fees and Swap Costs: What Quotes Include
item.description: Bridge quotes cover cross-chain transfer charges; swap costs add trading fees and price impact. Compare the amount received, network gas and every route step.

item.title: Five Steps to Recover a Stuck Cross-Chain Swap
item.description: A stuck cross-chain swap needs a chain-by-chain check: verify the source transaction, trace the bridge, then use the route’s documented recovery path.
